long_description:
🎃✨ Move, glow & create together!

Join us for a special Mother-Daughter Glow Pilates morning in Downtown Dallas, designed for girls ages 6–12 and their moms or special adult women.

Enjoy a fun, beginner-friendly Pilates + yoga experience created to keep both moms and girls moving and engaged. After class, we’ll switch from movement to creativity with glow bracelet-making, Halloween music and time to enjoy the beautiful studio together. 💕✨

👻 Halloween costumes are welcome, but not required — just make sure you can comfortably move!

📍 Downtown Dallas

🗓 Saturday, October 31 at 9:30 AM

⏱ 90-minute experience

🎀 Girls ages 6–12

✨ Limited spaces available

Come make a little Halloween memory together. 💕🎃
